summary: Hercules Capital filed an 8-K reporting that on September 17, 2026 its board expanded from seven to eight directors and elected Alfred B. Fichera as an independent Class I director, term expiring 2029, filling the vacancy; he will serve on the Audit Committee. The board determined he satisfies NYSE independence standards and is not an interested person under Section 2(a)(19). No arrangements or related-party transactions were disclosed. He receives standard non-employee director retainers and restricted stock plus an indemnification agreement. No deal terms; this is a routine board appointment, not a special situation.
